title: Customer Feedback Credit — Missing-Items Disputes on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** In a missing-items dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the feedback credit follows the most recent customer rating given on the disputed violation's batch: 5 stars give a feedback credit of 2 points; 4 stars give 1 point; 3 stars or fewer, or no rating, give no credit.

Only the most recent rating on that batch is read. Where the batch carried several orders and more than one was rated, the latest rating decides.

| Most recent rating on the batch | Feedback credit |
|---|---|
| 5 stars | 2 points |
| 4 stars | 1 point |
| 3, 2 or 1 stars | None |
| No rating | None |

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A Double Delivery Batch rated 3 stars on Monday and 5 stars on Tuesday: the latest rating is 5 stars — 2 points.
- The same batch rated 5 stars on Monday and 3 stars on Tuesday: the latest is 3 stars — no credit.
- A batch never rated: no credit.
